messages.subject: Wide vs. Long Format
parts:
Hi there,

I am fairly new to Unmarked and currently have my data set up in WIDE format. Is this what most people use? I seem to be running into loads of issues that all stem from the wide format, where my observation covariates (across 14 visits) are treated as 14 different variables. For example, I cannot figure out how to re-scale my observation covariates, as each of them has been scaled independently.

How do people deal with wide format? Or is Long format the way to go??

Sean

messages.author: 39971e2c19b8ec70
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Wide vs. Long Format
parts:
Hi Sean!

Seems that you are struggling with data fiddling in R, moreso than
with the unmarked package itself, right? If yes, I recommend package
reshape2, functions melt and dcast (or acast). You can google some
tutorials like e.g. this one:

http://www.cookbook-r.com/Manipulating_data/Converting_data_between_wide_and_long_format/

And you can also ask R questions on stackoverflow.com - there are many
people to help you with basic R stuff.

Tomas
